$comment_setup: Project-scoped MCP servers for Claude Code. Commit this file to git. Secrets come from environment variables — never hardcode tokens here. See README at the bottom for env vars to set.

postgres.$comment: Postgres MCP Pro by Crystal DBA. Read-only by default — safe for vibe coding. The official @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres was deprecated July 2025 due to a SQL injection CVE; do NOT use it.

github.$comment: Official GitHub MCP server. PRs, issues, repo navigation. Needs a fine-grained PAT with repo access.

context7.$comment: Pulls live, version-correct docs for libraries (React 19, FastAPI, LangChain, etc). Kills hallucinated APIs.

playwright.$comment: Browser automation for verifying UI changes end-to-end. Pairs with the existing Playwright e2e tests in tests/e2e/.
